approach: The 360 default.xex statically recompiled to x86-64 C++ with ReXGlue, a game-specific runtime standing in for the Xbox, drawn by the SDK's Xenos renderer on Vulkan only (no D3D12). Windows first, then native Linux and the Steam Deck.
notes: Started 2026-10-29 with the shape and lessons of the sister 360 recomps (DOA4, LOTR Conquest, Quake 4, DOAX2, GRAW, F.E.A.R.). id Tech 4 engine (Human Head / Venom Games port). Goal: main menu and a new game on Windows, gamepad first, keyboard and mouse where the engine kept them, then Linux. No game data included: bring your own Xbox 360 copy.
